items.title: Difference Between Prediction and Causation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Difference Between Prediction and Causation' under topic 6.9 (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Prediction purane (historical) data ki bunyad par andaza lagati hai ke kya ho sakta hai. Is ka dhyan aane wale nataij par hai: model purani maloomat se aane wali values ya waqiat ka andaza lagata hai. Misal: model pichhle marks, hazri aur parhai ke ghanton se talib-e-ilm ke aakhri grade ka andaza laga sakta hai. Isi tarah weather model purane mausam ke record se kal ke darja-e-hararat (temperature) ka andaza laga sakta hai. Model asal wajah samjhe baghair bhi durust andaza laga sakta hai. Isi liye prediction sales forecasting, stock ke trends, bimari ke khatre aur talaba ki performance ke andaze jaise kaamon mein mufeed hai.

Causation, doosri taraf, batata hai ke koi cheez kyun hoti hai: yeh variables (badalne wali cheezon) ke darmiyan sabab aur asar ke rishte dhoondta hai, yani waqiat ki wajah aur yeh ke ek factor doosre par seedha kaise asar dalta hai. Misal: agar baqaida parhai ke ghante seedha imtihan ki performance behtar karte hain to parhai ka waqt achhe grades ka sabab mana ja sakta hai. Isi tarah agar smoking (tambaku noshi) seedha phephron ki bimari ka khatra barhati hai to yeh causal (sabab wala) rishta hai. Faislon ke liye causality samajhna zaroori hai, kyunke yeh ghalat mafroozon se bachati hai aur asal masloon ki gehri samajh deti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Do cheezon ka saath saath barhna sabab ka saboot nahi. Misal: garmiyon mein ice-cream ki farokht aur doobne ke waqiat dono barhte hain; ek se doosre ka andaza lag sakta hai, lekin dono ki wajah garam mausam hai.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, andaza (kya hoga?): number aur hazri jaisa pichhla data model mein jata jo mumkina aakhri grade ka andaza deta; wajah jaane baghair durust ho sakta. Daen panel, sabab (kyun hota hai?): sabab, baqaida parhai, se teer asar, behtar grades, tak; sabab tajrubaat se sabit jo aik awamil badal kar baqi muqarrar rakhein, maslan tambaku noshi se phephron ki bimari; do cheezon ka saath barhna sabab sabit karne ke liye kafi nahi.
blocks.caption: Andaza aur sabab (6.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Andaza 'aage kya?' ka jawab deta aur sabab 'kyun?' ka; achhe faislon ko aam taur par dono chahiye.

blocks.prompt: Ek model dekhta hai ke jin talaba ke ghar zyada kitabein hain un ke marks zyada hain. Kya is se sabit hota hai ke kitabein khareedne se marks barhte hain? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Yeh andaze ke liye mufeed pattern hai, sabab nahi. Doosre factors, jaise ghar walon ki madad ya parhne mein guzra waqt, dono ki wajah ho sakte hain; sabab dikhane ke liye aisa experiment chahiye jo sirf kitabon ki tadaad badle.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa: 6.9 Predictive Modeling and Causality

items: Prediction: purane patterns se batati hai ke kya ho sakta hai; wajah samjhe baghair bhi durust ho sakti hai.
Causation: batata hai kyun; sabab aur asar, aksar experiments se.
Saath badalne wale patterns sabab ka saboot nahi.
